description: This file defines an interface for a thread-safe blocking queue data structure in C. It includes function prototypes for creating, destroying, enqueueing, dequeueing, deleting, iterating, and managing the state of the queue, along with related callback function types and constants. It provides mechanisms for handling timeouts and custom memory management for contained items.

methods.name: blockingQueueCreate
methods.description: Creates a new blocking queue with specified maximum capacity.

methods.name: blockingQueueDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the queue and releases associated memory, optionally using a custom free function for each item.

methods.name: blockingQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the queue.

methods.name: blockingQueuePush
methods.description: Enqueues an item to the end of the queue.

methods.name: blockingQueuePushTimeout
methods.description: Enqueues an item, blocking up to the specified timeout if the queue is full.

methods.name: blockingQueuePushTimeoutGranular
methods.description: Enqueues an item, blocking with nanosecond precision timeout.

methods.name: blockingQueuePop
methods.description: Removes and returns the next item from the queue, blocking indefinitely.

methods.name: blockingQueuePopTimeout
methods.description: Removes and returns the next item, waiting up to the specified timeout.

methods.name: blockingQueuePopTimeoutGranular
methods.description: Removes and returns the next item, with nanosecond precision timeout.

methods.name: blockingQueueDelete
methods.description: Searches for an item matching a value and deletes it from the queue.

methods.name: blockingQueueIterate
methods.description: Iterates over each item in the queue, calling a callback function.

methods.name: blockingQueueClear
methods.description: Clears all items from the queue, optionally freeing memory with a custom function.

methods.name: blockingQueueDisable
methods.description: Disables the queue from accepting new items and unblocks any blocking calls.

methods.name: blockingQueueIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the queue is currently disabled.
